key: Hello. Admittance to these apartments is for tenants only.
en: Hello. Admittance to these apartments is for tenants only.
ja: こんにちは。このアパートへの立ち入りは、入居者の方に限らせていただいております。

key: I'm afraid you'll have to leave.
en: I'm afraid you'll have to leave.
ja: 恐れ入りますが、お引き取りください。

key: Therefore, please go on.
en: Therefore, please go on.
ja: それでは、お進みください。

key: Good day. Admittance to these apartments is for residents only.
en: Good day. Admittance to these apartments is for residents only.
ja: こんにちは。このアパートへの立ち入りは、居住者の方に限らせていただいております。

key: For security purposes, I must ask you to please leave.
en: For security purposes, I must ask you to please leave.
ja: 防犯上の理由から、お引き取りいただかなければなりません。

key: Fortunately, I've already been informed that you're a new "resident".
en: Fortunately, I've already been informed that you're a new "resident".
ja: 幸い、あなたが新しい「入居者」だとすでに伺っております。

key: Please, go ahead.
en: Please, go ahead.
ja: どうぞ、お進みください。

key: Please go on.
en: Please go on.
ja: どうぞ、お進みください。

key: MANNIE: Heyyyy buddy, you wanna go?
en: MANNIE: Heyyyy buddy, you wanna go?
ja: マニー: よお相棒、行きたいのか?

key: Not a prob', bro. Down to 7th it is.
en: Not a prob', bro. Down to 7th it is.
ja: 問題ないぜ、兄弟。7番街まで行くとしよう。

key: For sure, pal. Lapis ahoy.
en: For sure, pal. Lapis ahoy.
ja: もちろんさ、相棒。ラピスへ出発だ。

key: KRIZ: Hey, where we goin'?
en: KRIZ: Hey, where we goin'?
ja: クリズ: おい、どこ行くんだ?

key: 7th, right? All right.
en: 7th, right? All right.
ja: 7番街だろ? よし。

key: Up we go and here we are!
en: Up we go and here we are!
ja: よいしょっと、着いたぞ!

key: KRIZ: Man, Reborn City just don't feel the same no more.
en: KRIZ: Man, Reborn City just don't feel the same no more.
ja: クリズ: なあ、リボーンシティってもう昔とは全然違う感じがするよな。

key: And how about our family?
en: And how about our family?
ja: それに、俺たちの家族はどうだ?

key: It ain't the same either.
en: It ain't the same either.
ja: それも、もう昔とは違う。

key: KRIZ: This stinks.
en: KRIZ: This stinks.
ja: クリズ: 最悪だな。

key: I used to depend on Maxwell to tell me what to do, how to live my life.
en: I used to depend on Maxwell to tell me what to do, how to live my life.
ja: 前は、マクスウェルに何をすべきか、どう生きるべきか、頼りきってたんだ。

key: He used to get me, but now he's lost me.
en: He used to get me, but now he's lost me.
ja: あいつは前は俺のことをわかってくれてたけど、今はもうついていけねえよ。

key: He thinks the best thing to do is get jobs?
en: He thinks the best thing to do is get jobs?
ja: 仕事を見つけるのが一番だって思ってんのか?

key: I didn't join this gang to get a job!
en: I didn't join this gang to get a job!
ja: 仕事するためにこの一味に入ったわけじゃねえのに!

key: If I could've done that, I would've done that in the first place!
en: If I could've done that, I would've done that in the first place!
ja: それができるんなら、最初からそうしてたっつーの!

key: But I ain't cut out for work. I'm not smart enough for it.
en: But I ain't cut out for work. I'm not smart enough for it.
ja: でも俺は、働くのに向いてねえんだよ。頭が良くねえからさ。

key: I can get up every day. I can dress myself. I can feed myself. And that's about it.
en: I can get up every day. I can dress myself. I can feed myself. And that's about it.
ja: 毎日起きられる。自分で服も着られる。自分でメシも食える。それくらいのもんだ。

key: I didn't ask for this adult life...
en: I didn't ask for this adult life...
ja: こんな大人の人生、望んでなかったのに……

key: Can I just get paid to do that? Why I gotta do more?
en: Can I just get paid to do that? Why I gotta do more?
ja: それだけやって金もらえないのか? なんでそれ以上やんなきゃいけないんだよ?

key: In fact, just pay me to eat. Love me some food.
en: In fact, just pay me to eat. Love me some food.
ja: っていうか、食うだけで金くれよ。飯、大好きなんだから。

key: And sleep. I'm a pro at sleeping.
en: And sleep. I'm a pro at sleeping.
ja: あと寝るのもだ。寝るのはプロ級だぜ。

key: But nobody's going to hire me for that, so what's the point?!
en: But nobody's going to hire me for that, so what's the point?!
ja: でもそんなことで雇ってくれる奴なんかいねえし、じゃあ何の意味があるんだよ?!

key: MANNIE: You ever think about everything we know is like...
en: MANNIE: You ever think about everything we know is like...
ja: マニー: 俺たちが知ってることって、全部こう……

key: It's always stuck in the past.
en: It's always stuck in the past.
ja: ずっと過去に取り残されてるって思わねえか。

key: You get that feeling, buddy?
en: You get that feeling, buddy?
ja: そういう感じ、わかるか、相棒?

key: I think I'm stuck in the past too.
en: I think I'm stuck in the past too.
ja: 俺も、過去に取り残されてる気がするんだ。

key: MANNIE: \PN! Buddy! You're just the one I wanted to talk to!
en: MANNIE: \PN! Buddy! You're just the one I wanted to talk to!
ja: マニー: \PN! 相棒! ちょうど話したかった相手だ!

key: I don't know what to do!
en: I don't know what to do!
ja: どうすりゃいいかわかんねえよ!

key: My main man Archer's all up with this "gainful life paths" bullshit,
en: My main man Archer's all up with this "gainful life paths" bullshit,
ja: 俺のダチのアーチャーが「実りある人生の道」とかいうたわ言に夢中でさ、

key: And sure, for someone who's as smart as you or him, that's no problem, but what about us?!
en: And sure, for someone who's as smart as you or him, that's no problem, but what about us?!
ja: そりゃ、お前やあいつみたいに頭が良けりゃ問題ないだろうけど、俺たちはどうすんだよ?!

key: You gotta think of the little guys, pal!
en: You gotta think of the little guys, pal!
ja: 底辺の連中のことも考えてくれよ、相棒!

key: I can't do anything!
en: I can't do anything!
ja: 俺には何もできねえんだ!

key: I'm only good at doing what I'm told!
en: I'm only good at doing what I'm told!
ja: 言われたことをやるのだけは得意なんだよ!

key: I need specific instructions! Go there, do this!
en: I need specific instructions! Go there, do this!
ja: 具体的な指示が要るんだ! あそこに行け、これをやれって!

key: Archer gives us that! Even the city reconstruction gave us that!
en: Archer gives us that! Even the city reconstruction gave us that!
ja: アーチャーはそれをくれるんだ! 街の復興作業だってそうだった!

key: But most jobs won't! So what gives?
en: But most jobs won't! So what gives?
ja: でも大抵の仕事はそうじゃねえ! じゃあどうしろってんだ?

key: You know what I mean, man?!
en: You know what I mean, man?!
ja: わかるだろ、なあ?!

key: "7th Street Level"
en: "7th Street Level"
ja: 「7番街レベル」

key: "Lapis Ward Level"
en: "Lapis Ward Level"
ja: 「ラピス区レベル」

key: 7th Street
en: 7th Street
ja: 7番街

key: Lapis Ward
en: Lapis Ward
ja: ラピス区
